_fonte: Pre-registered grid of the event-fusion addendum (Corollary 4(b), family CMP). Single source read by the analytic table (code/fusion_analytic_table.py) and by the literal token-budget simulation (code/run_fusion.py). Frozen: never edit after its sha256 is recorded; any change goes to a new dated deviation file.
_custos: k in tokens per event, reused from the token-budget test (illustrative): 14 = compact transaction, 55 = plain-text transaction; K = 2048 = context length of the case model. The cost k_fund of a fused event does NOT come from the case: reusing 14 or 55 is an illustrative choice.
_bracos: Arms per cell: R = current mix only; RS = new source S raw; RF = S fused without loss in blocks of m events (rate lam/m, separation sqrt(m)*d, cost k_fund); RP = control with d NOT preserved, each block keeps only the x of its most recent member (rate lam/m, separation d, cost k_fund).
_fluxo: Random stream: numpy.random.default_rng([seed, i_cell, i_stream, tag, i_block]); i_cell = 0-based position in celulas; i_stream 0 = arm R, 1 = one draw shared by RS, RF and RP (fusion is a post-draw transform); blocks of bloco_usuarios users. tag 7 is exclusive to this family (tag 3 = token-budget test; 5, 6 and 8 = the other three families).
_tol_0: Null tolerance of the CMP6 RF - RS contrast: ceil(3 * ep_dif_max_kat * 1e4) / 1e4, where ep_dif_max_kat is the largest ep_dif in the sealed token-budget summary (cell S1a).
_discrimina: Pairs [contrast, rival]: tok = a fused event is worth ONE event (the RP model); ideal = loss does not matter (the RF model); dia = per-day separability lam*d^2 decides (zero); m = factor m ignoring k_fund; cor1_sem_saturacao = Corollary 1 with the fused rho, saturation unchecked (sign); monotonia = a source with d > 0 never hurts (sign); p1 = Proposition 1 (h = K/W), saturation unchecked; nulo = null contrast.
_pisos: Design floors, checked by the analytic table before any simulation: every arm at |z| >= z_minimo_regime on its declared side; at most eventos_max_por_usuario generated events per user; a contrast enters the criterion only if |dAUC| >= margem_minima_sobre_tol * tol and >= 3 * EP.
